text: The searches returned no existing document content. I will seed the independent 500 mA specification, with explicit budget assumptions and verification obligations. This change affects requirements documents only; candidate-part suitability, current-budget closure, and physical validation remain unverified.

args.why: Establish traceable requirements for the new protected USB-C 500 mA prototype without inheriting the earlier 3 A / USD 3 brief or representing supplied research as independently verified evidence.
args.what_changes:
- Create docs/SPEC.md with product scope, original requirements, separately identified design decisions, ASSUMED defaults, evidence provenance, and outstanding verification.
- Populate a substantive ## Budgets section covering 4.75-5.25 V operation, 500 mA total normal continuous external load, strictly below 2 mA unloaded VBUS current, below USD 8 component BOM at quantity 100, and the 40 x 30 mm target envelope. Include a complete preliminary unloaded-current accounting framework with explicit conditions, worst-case allocations, unresolved contributions, and no double counting. Do not claim a verified total when any contribution lacks a supported upper bound.
- Specify separate CC1/CC2 5.1 kohm Rd, a known-capable source/cable operating condition, common active high-side protection before both outputs and the LED, parallel-output polarity requirements, manual-assembly restrictions, and required local-library/pin/footprint verification.
- Preserve MIC2544-2YM, 301 ohm 1% RSET, 10 kohm 1% LED resistance, capacitor values, and USB4105-GF-A as provisional candidates. Attribute supplied datasheet and dated distributor observations accurately and retain their limitations.
- Record no programmable device/no onboard firmware as a requirement and applicability conclusion; retain the real firmware-stage outcome and all eight pipeline stages. State that no prototype has been manufactured or physically tested.
- Seed per-capability Given/When/Then requirements under openspec/specs/ if the workspace exists, including one established by the proposal workflow. Update the decision/constraint records through the available validated workflow.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Validate this proposal before editing any design file.
- [ ] Write docs/SPEC.md, labeling every unstated default ASSUMED and giving a one-line rationale for each decision.
- [ ] Build a complete preliminary worst-case unloaded VBUS-current budget, including LED, enabled switch, programming/control, pull-ups, capacitor/protection/connector leakage, and every other fitted VBUS-fed load; identify datasheet supply-current inclusions, source conditions, uncertainties, and evidence needed to close the budget. Keep CC-source current distinct from VBUS-input current.
- [ ] Record every stated budget and every stated, assumed, or discovered constraint with record_constraint when available; record non-trivial decisions with record_decision.
- [ ] Explain that the 500 mA normal external load is distinct from current-limit thresholds and LED overhead; retain the provisional 0.530-1.003 A limit range and its verification conditions without asserting guaranteed operation across unverified conditions.
- [ ] Specify current limiting/foldback and thermal cycling as supplied candidate research requiring exact-device confirmation; require physical inrush, overload, sustained-short, recovery, voltage-drop, and thermal tests in the later bring-up plan.
- [ ] Define or explicitly flag proposed output pin assignments and polarity for later exact-symbol/footprint validation; retain the fine-pitch USB connector assembly-risk note.
- [ ] If an OpenSpec workspace exists, add per-capability Given/When/Then scenarios for attachment/source conditions, protected parallel outputs, power indication/current consumption, manual assembly/mechanics, and evidence/firmware applicability.
- [ ] Check document consistency and drift, resolve applicable obligations, and finish the specification stage without claiming schematic, PCB, firmware-build, or physical-test results not obtained.
